recommendation: Keep this fixed commit. The authoritative NutritionOrder source now has the requested supporting-information element connected to the Request pattern; deferred elements should remain with later targeted issues or future OO decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-36664 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5 by OO. It asked for NutritionOrder to implement additional Request pattern elements, with the final scope adding basedOn, priority, supportingInfo, performer, and an enteralFormula delivery-device performer element; it left replaces, groupIdentifier, statusReason, doNotPerform, insurance, reason, occurrence, and requested food delivery for later consideration or extensions.
initial_application: Git commit 5beeee0cf095be40008c2e3de9b20629668b1290 applied the main R5 changes by adding NutritionOrder.basedOn, NutritionOrder.priority, NutritionOrder.supportingInformation, NutritionOrder.performer, and NutritionOrder.enteralFormula.deliveryDevice. Later refactors preserved these elements, and FHIR-43447's applied commit 420cc15cd2ae94a67e86a8378118c1e00cfdfdfc added a missing workflow mapping for NutritionOrder.performer. The root supportingInformation element still lacked its Request.supportingInfo workflow mapping.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes nutritionorder=NutritionOrder, so the edited NutritionOrder StructureDefinition and mapping exception files are in current build scope. FHIR-37965 separately resolved the groupIdentifier item that FHIR-36664 deferred, and FHIR-43447 later re-reviewed NutritionOrder against the Request pattern while confirming several other Request elements had no current use case. Both related issues are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Added the workflow mapping from NutritionOrder.supportingInformation to Request.supportingInfo, added the matching Request-pattern mapping exception, and added the expected name-difference warning suppression for the intentionally named NutritionOrder.supportingInformation element.
source_changes: source/nutritionorder/structuredefinition-NutritionOrder.xml: added a workflow mapping from NutritionOrder.supportingInformation to Request.supportingInfo.
source/nutritionorder/nutritionorder-request-mapping-exceptions.xml: added the divergent Request.supportingInfo mapping exception for NutritionOrder.supportingInformation.
source/suppressed-workflow-warnings.xml: added the expected Different element names suppression for NutritionOrder.supportingInformation.

related_jiras.note: Separately added NutritionOrder.groupIdentifier and its search parameter after FHIR-36664 deferred groupIdentifier for future consideration; already represented on the combined branch.

Later R6 NutritionOrder workflow-pattern review removed instantiates and fixed performer/product mappings while confirming several other Request elements had no current use case; already represented on the combined branch.
